stepNotes.1: Inventoried the four in-scope files (auth/oauth-callback/oauth-provider/trust) plus confirmed out-of-module callers: McpAuth.clearCodeVerifier at impl.ts:1475 and two McpOAuthProvider constructions at impl.ts:558,1311 and mcp-impl.ts:948.

stepNotes.6: No empty catches, TODOs, or dead exports found; PENDING_AUTHS_MAX=100 with evictOldestPendingAuth is justified defense-in-depth, not speculative; fixedState is reachable via the CLI headless path.
